- total_focus_s (int)
- total_idle_s (int)
- top_app (string, most focus time)
- avg_kpm (int, average keys per minute across keypress windows, rounded)
- productivity_label: high/medium/low

Label rule:
- high if idle_ratio < 0.2 and avg_kpm >= 80
- medium if idle

- total_idle_s (int)
